units.source_text: 但在玉鬘本人想来，倘是生身父亲内大臣的信，即使只有三言两语，也是很可喜的，

en.t: But to Tamakazura herself, if it were a letter from her own father, the Minister of the Interior, even just a few words would have made her very happy,

units.source_text: 而和这源氏太政大臣素不相识，如何可去依附他呢？

en.t: whereas she had never even met this Genji, the Grand Minister; how could she possibly go and depend on him?

units.source_text: 她嘴上虽然不说，心中很不乐意。

en.t: Although she said nothing aloud, in her heart she was very unwilling.

units.source_text: 右近便开导她，教她此时应该如何应付。

en.t: Ukon therefore reasoned with her and taught her how she ought to respond at this moment.

units.source_text: 别的侍女也对她说：“小姐到了太政大臣家里，身份自然高贵起来，内大臣也会来寻访小姐了。

en.t: The other gentlewomen also said to her, "Once you go to the Grand Minister's house, my lady, your status will naturally rise, and the Minister of the Interior will come looking for you too.

units.source_text: 父女之缘是决不会断绝的。

en.t: The bond between father and daughter will never be severed.

units.source_text: 像右近那样身份低微的人，发愿寻找小姐，向神佛祈祷，神佛不是果然引导了她么？

en.t: Even someone of such low rank as Ukon vowed to search for you and prayed to the gods and Buddhas; did they not indeed guide her to you?

units.source_text: 何况小姐与内大臣身份如此高贵，只要大家平安无事……”

en.t: How much more certain it must be for you and the Minister of the Interior, both of such noble rank, so long as everyone remains safe..."

units.source_text: 先得写封回信，大家催她快写。

en.t: First she had to write a reply, and everyone urged her to write quickly.

units.source_text: 玉鬘深恐露出乡下人相，羞涩不敢动笔。

en.t: Tamakazura was deeply afraid of revealing herself as rustic and, feeling shy, did not dare take up the brush.

units.source_text: 侍女们便取出一张香气熏得很浓的中国纸来，劝她快写。

en.t: The gentlewomen then brought out a sheet of Chinese paper heavily perfumed with incense and urged her to write at once.
